references.text: The expression "What have we to do with you" also appears here, used in a similar context of addressing a spiritual entity.
The expression "What have we to do with you" is used in a similar situation where a spiritual power is confronted.
Jesus uses a similar expression "What have I or you to do with each other", which indicates a distance or difference in mission or identity.
The reference to "the holy one" can be linked to the description of a high and pure priest, pointing forward to Jesus as "the Holy One of God".
